subject: general
question: Who became Punjab's Chief Minister after election in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagwant Mann.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagwant Mann**, an Indian politician from the** Aam Aadmi Party (AAP),** has been **Punjab's 17th chief minister since 2022.**
 
• He was elected in 2022 to the Punjab Legislative Assembly, serving the **Dhuri Assembly constituency.**
 
• He was a member of the **Lok Sabha for the Sangrur** Lok Sabha seat from **2014 until 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amarinder Singh** is an Indian politician who served as the **15th Chief Minister of Punjab**. He has served as the Chief Minister of Punjab from 2002 to 2007 and 2017 to 2021.Furthermore, he served as the **Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee's president.** 
 
• **Charanjit Singh Channi **became the **first Dalit Chief Minister of Punjab** after Amarinder Singh's resignation in September 2021. He belonged to the **Indian National Congress** party.
 
• **Parkash Singh Badal** is a senior politician and **former Chief Minister of Punjab**. He belonged to the **Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) party.**
